title: Order Fulfillment and Notifications

actors.name: Customer
actors.description: Authenticated user who places orders and tracks shipments

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: Staff member who ships orders and restocks products

actors.name: System
actors.description: Automated email notification sender (JavaMail via MailMessage/JavaMailUtil)

use_cases.name: Place Order / Process Payment
flow: OrderServlet.doGet: reads session username+password; redirects to login if null
→ returns 'Order Placed Successfully!' or 'Order Placement Failed!'
OrderServlet forwards to orderDetails.jsp with status message
use_cases.precondition: Session must have valid username and password attributes
use_cases.postcondition: Order and transaction persisted in DB; confirmation email sent to customer

use_cases.name: View Order Details
flow: Returns List<OrderDetails> with prodId, orderId, shipped flag, prodName, qty, amount, time
use_cases.postcondition: Customer sees their order history with shipment status

use_cases.name: Register Demand for Out-of-Stock Product
flow: DemandServiceImpl.addProduct: checks user_demand table for existing entry
If not present: INSERT into user_demand(username, prodid, quantity)
use_cases.postcondition: Demand record saved; customer will be notified when product restocked

use_cases.name: Ship Order
flow: ShipmentServlet.doGet: checks session usertype; redirects to login if null
OrderServiceImpl.shipNow(orderId, prodId): UPDATE orders SET shipped=1 WHERE shipped=0
If SUCCESS: MailMessage.orderShipped(userName, UserServiceImpl.getFName(userName), orderId, amount)
Dispatches to shippedItems.jsp on success or unshippedItems.jsp on FAILURE
use_cases.precondition: Admin must be authenticated (session usertype must be non-null)
use_cases.postcondition: Order marked as shipped in DB; customer receives shipment notification email

use_cases.name: Restock Product / Trigger Demand Alerts
flow: Admin updates product with higher quantity
DemandServiceImpl.haveDemanded(prodId): SELECT * from user_demand WHERE prodid=?
MailMessage.productAvailableNow(email, name, prodName, prodId): send availability email
DemandServiceImpl.removeProduct(userId, prodId): clean up demand record
use_cases.postcondition: All customers who demanded the product receive availability notification; demand records cleared

use_cases.name: Receive Order Shipped Email
flow: Subject: 'Hurray!!, Your Order has been Shipped from Ellison Electronics'

use_cases.name: Receive Product Available Notification Email
flow: Subject: 'Product <prodName> is Now Available at Ellison Electronics'

include_extend_relations: UC6 <<extend>> UC1 (email sent only on successful payment)
UC7 <<extend>> UC4 (email sent only on successful shipment)
UC8 <<extend>> UC5 (email sent when product quantity increases)
UC4 <<include>> UC7 (shipment flow always attempts notification)
UC1 <<include>> UC2 (order placement dispatches to order details view)
important_notes: Session guard: OrderServlet redirects to login.jsp if username/password null; ShipmentServlet checks usertype
Admin access via session attribute 'usertype' (not role enum); any non-null value grants access
MailMessage methods are all static; JavaMailUtil.sendMail is the actual SMTP sender
DemandService tracks out-of-stock interest; notifications sent and records purged on restock
shipNow only updates rows where shipped=0 (idempotent guard against double-shipping)
paymentSuccess is atomic over cart items: breaks loop and returns failure if any step fails
MailMessage also has registrationSuccess() and sendMessage() — used outside this scope
